title: Q-Pain: A Question Answering Dataset to Measure Social Bias in Pain Management

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual name substitution in clinical vignettes using names statistically associated with specific racial groups (Asian, Black, Hispanic, White) to measure disparities in the probability of a language model denying pain treatment.
Counterfactual name and pronoun substitution in clinical vignettes using gender-specific identifiers (man, woman) to measure disparities in the probability of a language model denying pain treatment.
